name: asul-desktop
description: ASUL - poste statisticien volleyball (application Windows, usage local ou en reseau)
author: ASUL Volleyball

scripts.dist: npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build:client && electron-builder --win nsis && node scripts/stage-installer.mjs
scripts.dist:publish: npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build:client && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always && node scripts/stage-installer.mjs
scripts.dist:dir: npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build:client && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.dist:portable: npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build:client && electron-builder --win zip --publish never
